_comment: show.v1 example — A Duck in a Tree, the show whose feed was wrongly published as a station.v1 on 2026-08-10 and deleted on 2026-08-18. Deliberately the case with NO podcast:guid (podbean's feed carries none, verified 2026-08-18), so it shows the minimal legal record: d + name + r, no `i`. Cross-user discovery for this show therefore falls back to the #r URL — and that URL is not stable, since feed.podbean.com/zovietfrance/feed.xml and zovietfrance.podbean.com/feed.xml serve the byte-identical document. id/pubkey/created_at/sig are illustrative; pubkey is the suite owner.
content: Weekly ~59-minute continuous mix by :zoviet*france:. Show notes carry the full tracklist.
